references.title: Tyre and brake thermal management in NASCAR
references.review_depth: publisher indexed abstract and equation excerpts; direct full-text request returned403; full derivation/data review remains required
references.use: Compare contact dissipation/temperature/wear coupling and brake thermal states. Do not transfer NASCAR fitted parameters to Pitgun.
references.limitation: Circuit, vehicle, tire and instrumented test conditions differ; no independent Pitgun parameter identification yet.

references.title: Tire Thermal Model for Enhanced Vehicle Dynamics Simulation
references.review_depth: publisher abstract and university bibliographic record; full equations not reviewed
references.use: Study how working conditions and temperature influence a brush-model force response.
references.limitation: Not evidence that one/two temperature states or a particular parameter set are adequate for this game.

references.title: FASTSim: A Model to Estimate Vehicle Efficiency, Cost and Performance
references.review_depth: laboratory publication abstract and metadata; not a completed implementation comparison
references.use: Reference for reduced-order vehicle energy flows, efficiencies, component power limits and regenerative braking.
references.limitation: Drive-cycle efficiency evidence does not validate racing tire forces or lap-time predictions.

references.title: Python Battery Mathematical Modelling (PyBaMM)
references.review_depth: official publications page and citation metadata
references.use: Candidate offline reference environment and guidance toward model-specific citations.
references.limitation: Software credibility is not battery parameter identification or validation of a Pitgun battery.

references.title: PyBaMM Thevenin model documentation
references.review_depth: model structure/options and thermal-coupling documentation reviewed
references.use: Compare a bounded energy-store model with OCV/resistance/one-RC dynamics if voltage/temperature constraints prove relevant.
references.limitation: An equivalent circuit still needs chemistry/cell-specific data; runtime dependency not introduced.

references.title: Induced Drag Coefficient
references.use: Explain the qualitative appui/drag tradeoff and reference-area consistency.
references.limitation: Finite-wing theory is not a validated whole-racecar aerodynamic map, especially with ground effect.

references.title: pypowsybl documentation
references.review_depth: network/load-flow/security-analysis API overview reviewed; no integration executed
references.use: Assess a future adapter using an existing network solver to test generic simulation/controller lifecycle.
references.limitation: A moving stable URL must be replaced by a pinned release/data set for an experiment. No RTE endorsement, data access or partnership is inferred.

publication_rule: Cite the exact equation/section actually adopted, disclose adaptation and review depth; never imply a bibliography validates unknown parameters.
